newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Nation of Islam's Farrakhan arrives in Libya.
newsitem.headline: Nation of Islam's Farrakhan arrives in Libya.

text.p: U.S. Nation of Islam leader Louis Farrakhan arrived in the Libyan capital Tripoli on Sunday, the official Libyan news agency JANA reported.
JANA, monitored in Tunis, gave no details about the visit of the controversial Black Muslim leader.
Libya awarded Farrakhan a human rights prize worth $250,000 during his last visit to the North African country in August.

But the U.S. Treasury Department had denied Farrakhan's application to receive the prize money or a $1 billion sum that Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi had pledged to the Nation of Islam after meeting Farrakhan in Libya in January 1996.

Farrakhan left Libya without the money and said he would mount a court battle to overturn the U.S. government's decision on the Libyan funds which he said would be used to build schools and business for blacks.
Washington had cited Libya's alleged role as "a strong supporter of terrorist groups" among reasons for the denial.
